connector.name: Sendinel
connector.registryDescription: AI-controlled email ops for campaigns, contacts, segments, analytics, and sending.
connector.summary: Hosted at sendinel.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.sendinel, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SENDINEL_API_KEY
env.description: Sendinel API key. Required for stdio startup and scopes the server to a project.
